extraction.title: Sequel struggles
extraction.subtitle: Why DeepSeek’s sequel failed to impress The AI lab faces stiffening competition and a meddling state
extraction.summary: DeepSeek's new AI model, v4, has not met expectations despite its competitive performance and low cost. The lab faces increasing competition from other Chinese AI firms and state interference, which complicates its operations.
